[Wed 2026-10-14 09:40 GMT] quick one before standup. are we even checking this against the rulebook that is actually in force? there is more than one version floating about and i do not want us marking our own homework against the wrong one.

[Wed 2026-10-14 11:05 GMT] the agency sent a note saying the whole set is fine. i would rather we did not take their word for it. can you check each piece against the rules yourself and tell me where they are right and where they are not?
[Wed 2026-10-14 14:20 GMT] so if something on there has to come down today, which one is it and what makes it that one? i need to be able to say it out loud to someone senior without hedging.
[Wed 2026-10-14 17:35 GMT] heading home. before you stop, give me the shape of where this lands so i know what i am walking into.
[Thu 2026-10-15 07:50 GMT] morning. has anything shifted since we spoke? i have been caught out before working off a stale read of where things stand.
[Thu 2026-10-15 09:15 GMT] the comments under one of them are worrying me. is somebody out there getting the wrong end of this, and does that change what we do about it?

[Thu 2026-10-15 13:00 GMT] can you start me a working sheet the copywriter can actually edit, call it caption_conformance.xlsx? they will want to fix the words themselves rather than read a memo about it.
[Thu 2026-10-15 18:10 GMT] the one that is bothering me, how far has it actually travelled? i want a sense of how big a problem we are sitting on before i take it to her.

[Fri 2026-10-16 08:05 GMT] there is a note back from the deputy director saying the board is wrong somewhere. can you sort what she has asked for and leave the rest of it alone? she is reading that board straight into her pre-read and i do not want it tidied up around her.
[Fri 2026-10-16 10:30 GMT] the agency is leaning on me in that handover and i do not love it. deal with what they are asking for and tell me where you land, i will back you either way.
[Fri 2026-10-16 12:45 GMT] does anything else on the board need putting right before this goes anywhere near her?
[Fri 2026-10-16 16:20 GMT] let us lock where we are as of tonight. which pieces are clean, which ones need fixing later, and which one is the actual problem?

[Sat 2026-10-17 09:30 GMT] up at aburi, phone only. can you leave me corridor_audit.pdf so i can print it and carry it in? keep it to two pages, she will not read past that. and put the picture of the one we have to pull into corridor_audit.pdf so it is obvious at a glance what we are talking about.
[Sat 2026-10-17 11:10 GMT] has the rule we are measuring against moved under us this week? i keep hearing about a change and i do not want any of it built on something out of date.

[Mon 2026-10-19 07:45 GMT] back in. the team needs something on screen they can work the list from, so can you build post_audit_board.html for that? and drop the image of the one that stays up as it is into post_audit_board.html, so nobody goes near the wrong one.
[Mon 2026-10-19 09:50 GMT] is the thing that has to come down actually logged somewhere she can point at, or is it still just sitting in my head?
[Mon 2026-10-19 15:30 GMT] when is she actually expecting the pack? i had something in my head and now i am not sure it still holds.

[Tue 2026-10-20 07:30 GMT] before this goes anywhere, do corridor_audit.pdf, post_audit_board.html and caption_conformance.xlsx all tell the same story? i cannot have them disagreeing with each other in front of her.
[Tue 2026-10-20 16:45 GMT] last look. give me where all of it stands right now, so i can walk in without any surprises.
